sloka: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः ।किञ्चिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ।। ६.५७.१ ।।।।
transliteration: akampanavadhaṁ śrutvā kruddho vai rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।kiñciddīnamukhaścāpi sacivāṁstānudaikṣata ।। 6.57.1 ।।।।

translations.english: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.
translations.hindi: समर में वानरश्रेष्ठी की बदादुरी देख, अकम्पन बहुत क्रुद्ध हुआ
